messages.content: 尋找全球PC版「鬥陣特攻」線上遊戲中任何玩家所達到的最高分數。

function.name: game_score_highest
function.description: Retrieve the highest score achieved by any player in a specific game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The name of the online game.
